tools.name: analyze_project
tools.description: Analyze a project directory to detect its tech stack, framework, package manager, project type, and tooling configuration. Returns structured JSON.

path.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

tools.name: map_architecture
tools.description: Scan a project's directory structure (up to 3 levels deep) and identify architectural layers, patterns, and organization. Returns the file tree, detected layers (routing, logic, data, etc.), and recognized patterns.

path.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

tools.name: extract_conventions
tools.description: Read a project's configuration files (tsconfig, eslint, prettier, editorconfig, package.json) and extract coding conventions and style rules. Returns structured settings so you know how to write code that matches the project's standards.

path.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

tools.name: generate_context
tools.description: Generate a complete project context document by analyzing the tech stack, architecture, and coding conventions. Returns a structured markdown summary that gives AI assistants full context about the project. This is the main tool — use it to understand any project quickly.

path.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the contents of a file at the given absolute path. Returns the full file content as text.

path.description: Absolute path to the file to read

tools.name: search_code
tools.description: Search for a text pattern across all files in a directory using grep. Returns matching lines with file paths. Useful for finding where a function, variable, or string is used.

pattern.description: Text or regex pattern to search for

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to current working directory
